description: This file contains SQL DDL statements for initializing the PostgreSQL database schema for UPSTDC Infrastructure Monitoring system. It defines tables for RBAC (roles, permissions, users, user_roles, role_permissions), domain objects (projects, tenders, contractors, funds, milestones, documents, project_progress, inspections, handovers, payments, audit_logs), along with associated indexes, constraints, and relationships. The script includes detailed schema design considerations such as soft deletes, geo fields, and polymorphic document management.
